batch: guanyu+zhangfei+zhaoyun+weiyan+huangzhong-grab-12combo (frames keyed by kind, so heroes share one file; victim collar rois are hero-independent)
units: roi = {x, y, w, h} in restored full source-cell pixels (density-2 px; cell = prepared frame srcW x srcH), authored by eye from the gridded 6x inspection crops in artifacts/motion/paired/measure-input/zoom/. Alpha >= 128 inside the roi is the measured point set. Left-facing samples reuse these rois mirrored via the trace flipX transform; no mirrored roi is authored.
inspectionCrops: artifacts/motion/paired/measure-input/ (full/ restored cells, grid/ 2x, zoom/ 3x and 6x targeted crops; regenerate with: node scripts/paired-contact-measure.mjs --render-input --crop guanyu:misc:5:270:70:100:80:6 --crop guanyu:misc:6:270:70:100:80:6 --crop soldier:hitstun-held:5:210:20:100:80:6 --crop spearman:hitstun-held:5:205:55:95:75:6 --crop archer:hitstun-held:5:205:25:100:70:6 --crop lidian:misc:2:190:50:110:80:6 --crop xiahoudun:misc:2:215:240:100:75:6 --crop xuchu:misc:2:190:45:110:80:6 ; zhangfei crops under measure-input/zhangfei/ via: node scripts/paired-contact-measure.mjs --hero=zhangfei --render-input --crop zhangfei:misc:2:300:90:110:70:6 --crop zhangfei:misc:3:180:80:120:95:6 ; zhaoyun crops under measure-input/zhaoyun/ via: node scripts/paired-contact-measure.mjs --hero=zhaoyun --render-input --crop zhaoyun:misc:2:380:90:110:70:6 --crop zhaoyun:misc:3:180:120:130:95:6 ; weiyan crops under measure-input/weiyan/ via: node scripts/paired-contact-measure.mjs --hero=weiyan --render-input --crop weiyan:misc:2:230:140:90:60:6 --crop weiyan:misc:3:220:120:90:60:6 ; huangzhong crops under measure-input/huangzhong/ via: node scripts/paired-contact-measure.mjs --hero=huangzhong --render-input --crop huangzhong:misc:2:300:120:110:70:6 --crop huangzhong:misc:3:300:130:110:70:6)

controls.plus6uVictimShift: victim displaced 6u along the lane/depth axis (display.y) AWAY from the gripping hand: dy = sign(collarRoiCentroidY - handRoiCentroidY) * 6u, computed mechanically per sample and recorded in the result. Gap must fail. A fixed +y shift is NOT a valid control for this batch (for lidian/xuchu the collar sits above the hand, so +y moves it INTO the hand), and a pin-axis (x) shift away from the holder is not valid either (the traced hand overshoots past the collar along x; kept as non-gated diagnosticPinAxisPlus6u).
controls.wrongPoseNote: guanyu misc:4 is the pre-grab pose (both hands on the polearm). The misc:5/6 hand roi falls on empty air there, so the gap must fail (null or > gate). This flat field is the legacy guanyu default; per-hero controls live in controls.byHero and take precedence in scripts/paired-contact-measure.mjs (wrongPoseFrame()).

guanyu.wrongPoseNote: Same as the legacy flat field above (kept in both places so older consumers still validate).

zhangfei.wrongPoseNote: zhangfei's settled-hold fist roi (misc:3) rests on his torso, so every misc cell (misc:0/1/4 included, alpha-probed 828/828 px) fills the rect identically and no misc pose can serve as a discriminating wrong pose for it. The control therefore uses the prone getup:0 cell, where the misc:3 roi falls on empty air (0 alpha px, probed), so the gap must fail (null). The misc-pose indiscriminability of this roi is a recorded limitation, not hidden: the +6u lane-shift control remains the discriminating negative control for zhangfei.

zhaoyun.wrongPoseNote: Same settled-fist limitation as zhangfei: zhaoyun's misc:3 fist roi rests against his torso and is fully alpha-filled (782/782 px probed) in every misc pose (and in fall/getup:1-4/jump/special cells), so no standing pose discriminates it. The control uses the prone getup:0 cell, where only a 110-px bottom strip (y174..180 of the rect) carries alpha, so the measured point set sits well below the real fist and the gap must fail. Recorded limitation, not hidden: the +6u lane-shift control remains the discriminating negative control for zhaoyun.

weiyan.wrongPoseNote: Same shaft-fist limitation: weiyan's misc:3 fist roi sits against sleeve/torso mass and carries heavy alpha in standing poses (misc:0 probed 400/418 px, misc:1 204, misc:4 95), so no standing misc pose cleanly discriminates it. The control uses the prone getup:0 cell, where only a 113-px bottom strip (y156..164 of the rect) carries alpha, so the measured point set sits below the real fist and the gap must fail. Recorded limitation, not hidden: the +6u lane-shift control remains the discriminating negative control for weiyan.

huangzhong.wrongPoseNote: Same weapon-fist limitation: huangzhong's misc:3 bow-grip fist roi sits in nearly the same spot in every standing misc pose (misc:0 probed 664/726 px, misc:1 656, misc:4 450 in this rect), so no standing misc pose cleanly discriminates it. The control uses the prone getup:0 cell, where only 7 alpha px fall in the rect (probed), so the measured point set is essentially empty/far from the real fist and the gap must fail. Recorded limitation, not hidden: the +6u lane-shift control remains the discriminating negative control for huangzhong.
